name: acc-battle-arena
description: ABA — ACC Battle Arena: side-by-side agent benchmarks (ACC vs no-ACC) with a live Vite battle arena. Real coding agents run inside isolated sandboxes with plan/act tasks and automatic project verification. Standalone; the ACC framework never depends on it.

scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ui install && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.prepare: node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('ui/dist/index.html')) { const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('npm --prefix ui install --no-audit --no-fund', { stdio: 'inherit' }); execSync('npm --prefix ui run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
